verdict.rationale: Brex's Global product page says it pays reimbursements to local bank accounts and avoids intercompany transactions, which matches the core of reimbursing abroad within Brex. It also supports budgets and spend limits in 100+ currencies. However, the support is a single marketing line: it never explicitly says reimbursements are paid out in the employee's local currency, and it gives no detail on the reimbursement workflow, countries covered or FX handling. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of local-currency reimbursement payouts, documentation of the international reimbursement flow and supported countries/currencies, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can reimburse employees abroad in their local currency without running a separate international payments process

citations.quote: Pay your global statements and reimbursements to and from local bank accounts to avoid intercompany transactions and accelerate payments.
Manage budgets and spend limits in over 100 currencies
